name: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations Associate

fee.note: Oracle offers this certification exam free, with a free learning path on Oracle MyLearn.

exam.format: Online multiple-choice exam on Oracle MyLearn: 40 questions in 60 minutes. The MyLearn exam URL marks it as unproctored, but the page also shows webcam and proctoring instructions.

free_routes.text: The exam is free on Oracle MyLearn, next to the free learning path that prepares for it.

access.retake: Oracle's general policy: online non-proctored exams can be retaken at any time, exams under a special promotion follow that promotion's terms, and a passed exam cannot be retaken.

scope: Agentic AI foundations on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI): agents, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Oracle-specific tools.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Oracle's guidelines say Oracle Cloud Infrastructure certifications are valid for 24 months, but the pages read do not say whether this credential counts as one, so no validity is listed.

Oracle's exam page, blog and MyLearn pages were blocked or rendered only in a browser for this check, so the passing score and any learning-path completion needed to unlock the free exam are not listed; confirm them on MyLearn.

prep.title: Oracle MyLearn: Become an Oracle Agentic AI Foundations Associate
